IMMERSIVE PORTALS Mod is Incredible! (Mod Showcase and Review)

human_notes._confidence: STRONG on mechanics, with one big caveat for questgen. Five narrated videos including a dedicated multi-part tutorial series (Repsack2 runs a 20+ episode season 1 plus a season 2; the two Ep1s and Ep2 were transcribed). Ids verified against immersive-portals-3.0.7-all.jar (Modrinth project immersive-portals-neoforge, loader forge, 1.20.1) - the jar registers only THREE items: portal_helper, portal_wand, command_stick. The videos are Fabric-side but the Forge port is the same qouteall codebase; the port was verified to exist before any GPU was spent.

entry.note: There is NO entry ritual and NO progression. The mod's survival-facing feature is passive: vanilla nether portals become see-through and walk-through with no purple fade, and the end portal drops you seamlessly into the End. A player 'enters' this mod the moment they light their first nether portal.

The first hands-on item every guide teaches is the Portal Helper block: outline a doorway of any size with helpers, light the inside with flint and steel like a nether portal, and it links to another similarly-shaped helper doorway. Frame blocks appear to vanish on lighting - guides pre-empt the panic: that is the sign it worked.
Mirrors are made with nothing but a glass wall lit with flint and steel - one of the mod's coolest features per the top tutorial, and the cheapest quest-sized task the mod offers.

order.note: Taught sequence across the corpus: 1) walk through a seamless nether portal, 2) portal helper doorways, 3) mirrors, 4) the portal wand (create / drag / copy modes, crouch-right-click to switch shape and mode), 5) command sticks and /portal commands for one-way conversion and deletion, 6) global portals, wrapping zones and dimension stacking, 7) config. Steps 4 onward are creative-inventory and command territory, not survival play.

The season-2 tutor states the wand supersedes the portal helper for portal creation, but the sticks stay necessary: the wand cannot make a portal one-way or delete connected portals. Wand-made portals are 'bi-way bi-faced' - four linked portals (eight parts) every time.

Dimension stacking is a world-creation toggle (more world options > dimension stack): the Nether generates directly under the Overworld with an obsidian seam you can dig through in survival; the End can sit overhead. This is the one command-free feature with real survival impact.

gates.note: FOR THE GENERATOR: nothing in this mod gates anything. All three items are effectively creative/operator tools (wand and sticks live in the creative inventory; custom portals are managed by /portal commands). Quest content should treat immersive_portals as a flavour layer on OTHER mods' portals - e.g. 'walk through your nether portal' - not as a questline of its own.

traps.note: Portals cannot be mined away. Breaking blocks leaves the portal floating; removal needs /portal delete_portal aimed at it, run on BOTH sides, because a linked pair renders as two portals.
A frameless portal viewed edge-on is a near-invisible sliver - guides warn you can genuinely lose your own portal. Keep at least a marker frame.
An outward wrapping zone locks space off so well you cannot get in to delete it: removal requires /portal global view_wrapping_zones and then four manual deletions, one per portal part.

The drag-portal stick can crash the game mid-drag, and the reviewer hit repeated failed portal links on camera; the mod is openly not finalized. Config warnings: the advanced client and server options can stop portals working or badly corrupt a game - the guide's advice is to leave them.
With Pehkui installed, walking through a portal pair of mismatched sizes RESIZES the player - seamless and easy to trigger by accident once someone builds scale portals.

signature.note: The see-through, animation-free nether portal is the mod to every reviewer - it is the first thing shown in all five videos. Mirrors and dimension stacking are the two runner-up features people actually build with.
